review_description: After 9 (!) solar quotes I ended up choosing Platinum Solar Group for the installation of my 13.2 kW solar system with Tesla Powerwall 3.There were a couple of other close contenders, however Platinum were able to supply and install everything within a week, which was actually before the start of the battery installation rebate (which began on November 1, 2024).  This is essentially what made me choose them over the others.Platinum promptly visited my house for a site inspection and nothing was an issue for them.  I told them exactly where I wanted the Powerwall and that I didn't want any cables running on the outside of the house.The next week, 4 guys turned up in a truck and had the system installed in around 4-5 hours.  Someone had forgotten to include the bird netting on their installation card, but this still wasn't an issue.  The guys went out for a late lunch while someone delivered the bird netting and they returned around an hour later to install it.  After another hour had passed, everything was installed and I was shown how to hook up the Powerwall to my wifi and Tesla app.The installation is very tidy - no cables running where they shouldn't be and everything is straight and centred.  Everything has been running fine for around 3 weeks since and I'm extremely happy!I wouldn't hesitate to highly recommend Platinum Solar Group to anyone looking for a quick and easy installation at a great price!

From start to finish Platinum Solar Group we’re very professional. The quoting process was very detailed and they didn’t push preferred brands but listened to what I wanted and advised best options. The install was very professional neat and tidy with all rubbish removed. I would strongly recommend Platinum Solar Group to anyone wanting to deal with a professional outfit.
Quoting was excellent value for quality, Installation was timely, quality and attitude, 1st class customer service, handled everything.
They were prompt and explained the process and how things worked, really well.
